title: The mgl-app-dev engine shipped its first end-to-end app.
summary: Was: no on-demand app builder. Now: intake to live in one engine, first app built and shipped.
body_md: The mgl-app-dev engine now runs the full on-demand app build cycle. Intake, registry check, brief, knowledge load, build via the web studio, layer-1 verify, registry update, knowledge handoff. First app built and shipped end to end. Reusable for any small internal tool that fits the tier profile.
why_this_way: Small tools kept dying in the gap between idea and build. The engine closes that gap. Anything that fits Tier 1 or Tier 2 can now go from ask to shipped without a full project spin-up.
